verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web UI framework, so desktop-app support is a fair axis for it. The evidence only covers server-rendered web output (Axum server, HTML/Markdown render targets, JS islands, FFI from other languages, adapting to other HTTP servers). Nothing documents building native desktop applications with Proa's component model or tooling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build native desktop applications by reusing my framework's component model and tooling
